Implemented on branch feat/fp-3prime-region-split-thresholds (93ecc58941): R-3 decouple gate (gate_loc=20000, gate_file_count=120) from fan-out (loc_threshold=3000 unchanged); gate_loc>size_upgrade_lines clamp invariant; R-1 _partition_reviewable_files filter-before-split (diff text un-mutated); R-2 fallback_exhausted->re-chunk guarded on len(specs)>1; R-4 config docs. 835 pytest pass, ruff clean.

Opus correctness review: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES. NO test illegitimately weakened (all 6 retargets verified legitimate; coverage increased); gate decouple + R-1 + R-2-no-loop + clamp/TP-safety all verified correct. REQUIRED before merge: (1) [important] route the R-2 re-chunk dispatch (runner.py ~2938-2951) through the same OVER_BOUND/_validate_large_diff_config gate the primary region-split path uses (~2772/2796-2823), with a test; (2) [minor] _file_count_threshold() (default 40) is now dead code AND CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE misdescribes its role — remove it or fix the doc. Recommended (non-blocking): R-2 merge-vs-replace on mixed results; clamp-boundary/warning test.
